Lead PM — BNPL, Amsterdam on-site.

Volta Pay (Amsterdam, 85 people, Series B, 3x growth) offers buy-now-pay-later at checkout across the Benelux. We're hiring a Lead PM to own the shopper app and credit decisions at checkout, leading two PMs. The role is on-site in Amsterdam four days a week; we offer full relocation support within Europe. You've shipped consumer-credit or BNPL product and have run pricing experiments.

label_v2.edge_note: relocation inside EMEA passes the relocation filter
